name: routines-app
title: Routines App — Authority-Layer Content Scenario
description: Build a Vrooli scenario that curates and executes step-by-step routines for cleaning, inspection, maintenance, and repair tasks (physical-domain). Closes the loop on the Morning Vision Walk chore-audit phase for physical chores the way new scenarios close the loop for digital chores. Targets Type-B users who want to be told what to do. v0 ships markdown-only routines with folder-per-routine layout, semantic search, and library + executor surfaces. Full vision, flexibility ladder, and explicit non-goals documented in the uploaded orchestration-summary.md.
